Template for stable, in-place, selection, search, and parallel sorting functions.

# Purpose
This file is a C template for generating type-specific sorting APIs for POD data. It uses macros such as `SORT_NAME`, `SORT_KEY_T`, and `SORT_BEFORE` to create a local set of functions for one key type and one order relation. The generated API includes insertion sort, stable merge sort with scratch space, in-place quick sort, selection by rank, and binary search for the first element greater than or equal to a query value. It also provides helper functions to validate the element count and to report the scratch alignment and footprint needed by the stable sort functions.

The file also supports optional thread-parallel sorting when `SORT_PARALLEL` is enabled. In that mode, it adds parallel versions of the stable sort and quick sort, plus a fast sample-based parallel sort that partitions the input across threads, sorts each partition, and then combines the results. The code is written so the same template can be included more than once in one compilation unit with different macro settings, which makes it a code generator for specialized sort implementations rather than a single fixed library file.
